notes.value: Deposit requirement steps up with loan size: minimum 10% deposit (90% LVR), rising to a minimum 25% deposit (75% LVR) for loans over $2m. Cash-out / equity release is not available on loans over $2m.

gaps: Tiimely Own is a direct-to-consumer digital product. No third-party broker accreditation channel is published — the "Tiimely Home broker" service is Tiimely's own in-house brokerage placing loans with a 30+ lender panel, not a channel for external brokers to submit to Tiimely Own. Status recorded as research_only for that reason.
No servicing parameters published — buffer, floor rate, DTI cap, rent shading, credit-card assessment and HEM treatment are all absent.
No income shading percentages published for overtime, bonus, commission, rental or Centrelink income; no statement on whether those income types are accepted at all.
No credit-history policy published (defaults, bankruptcy, arrears, enquiries).
The eligibility page is undated, so every asAt on this record is the date the page was read (2026-07-29) rather than a stated policy effective date.
No published postcode / location list behind the "capital city or major regional centre" test.
Maximum loan term, interest-only availability and offset/redraw features are not stated on the eligibility page.
